intro: The startup pivoted eleven times in one quarter, and the engineers learned to count by what got left behind. Each departure emptied a desk, and the new occupant of each desk found one thing still there: a coffee mug with someone else's name, a charger that does not fit their laptop, a badge that opens every floor. Nobody throws these away; the rituals of the place demand they stay, though nobody says why. The whiteboard, meanwhile, still carries the last pivot's diagram, and nobody is allowed to erase it.
echo: The investors are hunting for a mythical beast worth a billion.

puzzles.title: Force Push

blocks.text: The knight sets out from c1: Nb3 Na1 Nc2 Nb4 Nc6 Na5 Nb7 Nd8.

partials.0b66bc5ebd2a9bbdca7e8b3462e278722922a4e0: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Those are chess moves. Which squares does the piece land on, and what's written there?
Start on the given square, play each move, and read the letter on every square it lands on.

puzzles.title: Offsite
puzzles.flavor: Take stock of everything you recognise.

blocks.text: Hidden in the grid: 8 words to do with the office.

partials.bb79b5d312e5d8f0f656da54931d7a25efd0f7af: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Once every theme word is found, is anything left unclaimed? Read it in order.
Find the theme words; the letters no word uses, read row by row, are the answer.
The hidden words are: BETA, CACHE, COMMIT, DEPLOY, MERGE, PIVOT, SERIES, STANDUP.

puzzles.title: Monday Deploy
puzzles.flavor: The picture is worth exactly one word.

partials.07d27b3473be6b9998bc619ad830fb3e518dc2e0: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: The numbers describe runs of filled squares. What picture could they be drawing?

puzzles.title: Postmortem
puzzles.flavor: Nothing was lost; everything simply moved over.

partials.0d0f9163e630f29fa5b9faffec54a22291d5915a: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Every letter is close to the right one. Close on what? Look down at your hands.
QWERTY: every letter was typed one key to the side. Try shifting each one back, both directions.

puzzles.title: Runway

partials.9c79c3577be2c220c086264ab5fb91b5739029c7: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: All the letters of a sentence are here, but not in rows. Try walking the grid the way a snail would.
Start in one corner and spiral inward along the edges; one corner and one direction read as a sentence.

puzzles.title: Hockey Stick
puzzles.flavor: The pipes have been knocking all night, and not at random.

partials.cc0e3b575f83551572ba0333bee197aa7ff6401a: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Always two numbers, never more than five. How would two prisoners spell through a wall with a 5×5 grid?
Tap code: the first count is the row, the second the column, in a 5×5 alphabet with no K.

meta.title: Meta: Series Z
meta.flavor: Everything arrived a little heavier than it left.
hints: Did every answer come out the right size the first time? Each had one letter too many. Did you keep them?
Take the extra letter from each feeder, in puzzle order.
